task: B stream compute timing and storage coupling feasibility
author: Codex; this task used no DeepSeek or Claude

decision.main_point: 现成SYSTEM和历史core-only二进制都不能交付本平台可信C_j。官方mm-large默认实际需要六槽96KiB、八OpenMP线程；原四槽模板必须修订。
decision.faithful_original_port: 原HERO/PULP八线程计时须原周期trace或匹配PE/runtime环境；当前SYSTEM没有。若改用单资源R2不等于复现原平台，但可以作为明确说明且完整计费的研究应用投影，不能据这种差别否定B。
decision.bounded_alternative: R2是合法的有界研究应用模型：同默认kernel算术/六槽依赖，显式增加96KiB有限端口SPM和单乘法器计算FSM，并和DMA/DDR同钟耦合。它测的是所定义新engine模型而非原8PE/CVA6软件周期；不能用固定猜delay。R1缺现成资产不代表不可行，构建范围由root裁决。
decision.ready_now: 只有C整数tile编译能力与关键计时/存储接口得到源码核实；没有C_j实测，没有新compute/SPM RTL，没有新Verilator展开或模型执行。
decision.recommended_next_step: 本轮由root完成来源/功能关口接受并登记目标周期和同钟SPM接入缺口；保留R1/R2具体预算。若未来选R2，先冻结新增计算/存储资源投影，再做有界私有模型；不自动转新accelerator平台，不写普通失效。
decision.new_innovation_claim: 本接口适配本身不构成新机制；不能把新添MAC算力、SPM端口或线程替代控制器免费计入待比较规则收益。

actual_kernel_contract.data_type: uint32_t; each product/add is modulo 2^32, not floating-point and not the earlier generic Q15 illustration
actual_kernel_contract.tile_definition: For fixed s,t, i=0..15 and j=0..15 each reduce k=0..255: C[i*256+t*16+j] = sum_k A[i*256+k]*B[j*256+k] modulo2^32.
actual_kernel_contract.important_reuse: A_s stays through all 16 t tiles; B stripes rotate every t and revisit for next s; C_s drains only after its 16 t tiles. B=2I input does not remove source MAC loops, and no zero-specialization may be assumed.
actual_kernel_contract.timing_in_source: TIME_DMA_AND_COMP is commented out. Optional hero_get_clk_counter brackets compute plus the OpenMP-for completion/barrier behavior, in the original accelerator domain; there is no returned measurement in the obtained source.
actual_kernel_contract.strong_simple_controls: Ordinary legal A/B reuse, registers/cache and allowed mapping preparation remain valid controls. Do not require artificially cold B at every s to manufacture translation loss.

executable_timing_routes.kind: Actual selected CVA6 RTL execution; not faithful eight-PE PULP execution
executable_timing_routes.kernel_interface: void hero_mm_tile_scalar(const uint32_t *a_local,const uint32_t *b_local,uint32_t *c_local,uint32_t width,uint32_t stripe_height,uint32_t t); exact arithmetic derived from mm-large.c214..227. Outer s/t and six slot generations live in an explicit controller contract.
executable_timing_routes.compile_interface: Freestanding rv64imac/lp64 C supports this tile and ordinary integer/fixed-point FIR/matmul without malloc, libc, OpenMP or HERO runtime. Application arithmetic, dimensions, overflow and alias contracts must be frozen; current official kernel is uint32 mod32.

minimal_adapter_files_proposed_not_writt.role: Instantiate current ariane core using selected existing configuration and AXI4 id4 request/response types; replace synthetic slv0 source, retain existing IOMMU/DMA/system fabric. Tie unused interrupts low. Choose boot directly to a bare-metal entry. Compile whole current core dependency list once; no PMCA/OS rebuild.

A real bounded AXI scratchpad endpoint on a separate mapped window/mst1, six16KiB generation-owned slots. Define finite ports/queues/latency; never route these slots to host DDR or let C++ read them for free. Exclude slot region from core cache or implement and charge actual coherence.

Exact scalar tile plus bare-metal init, six-slot wait/ready publication, counter/marker boundaries and final write visibility. Removal of eight OpenMP workers changes compute-resource contract and is explicitly reported.
Load ELF or flat binary into modeled memories without FESVR dependence, advance core/SPM/DMA/DDR on the same tick, record retired marker/actual SPM commit events and check final products and quiet.

executable_timing_routes.measures: Cycles of the actual configured CVA6, including instruction fetch/data memory stalls and explicitly implemented synchronization. Counter reads/markers and code/stack traffic are real work; no wallclock or instruction-to-cycle constant.
executable_timing_routes.clock: One clk_i and one host tick g_cycle for core, DMA/IOMMU, scratchpad and DDR. Report cycles only until current FPGA frequencies/timing are independently verified.
executable_timing_routes.memory: Code/stack and any external loads must use their modeled AXI path. Slots require separately paid96KiB storage; uncached local access is safest for a small bridge. Six DDR buffers would instead define a DDR-resident application with real shared DDR service, not local SPM.
executable_timing_routes.synchronization: Compute start only after correct A/B generations truly loaded, C generation free and preceding tile completed. Compute done must cover the final C store reaching memory and outstanding stores drained; bare counter/retire return alone is not DMA-visible completion. Core polling/MMIO and DMA programming must actually traverse modeled interfaces or be reported as charged controller steps.
executable_timing_routes.same_time_coupling: Possible through ariane AXI slv0 and new actual SPM endpoint; not present in existing executable. Independent standalone core timing can give only that standalone memory/configuration cost; injecting its C_j constant into shared DDR does not reproduce instruction/data contention, cache-state changes, synchronization or data-dependent delays.
executable_timing_routes.setup_cost: At least one new core Verilator build, bare-metal loader/startup, scratchpad endpoint, software/controller synchronization and independent correctness checks. This is a moderate new testbench, not a ready one-file run.
executable_timing_routes.faithfulness_limit: Single-core scalar platform projection must not be labeled original eight-PULP-PE benchmark timing. Using Linux libgomp on one CVA6 core merely time-shares workers and adds a different runtime.

executable_timing_routes.kind: Explicit compute-resource model coupled to actual DMA/IOMMU; not actual CVA6 software and not original PULP eight-thread timing
executable_timing_routes.kernel_interface: start(s,t,a_slot,a_generation,b_slot,b_generation,c_slot,c_generation,width,stripe_height); ready/start handshake; done and last committed C-write events carry s,t,generation. Execute mm-large tile address and uint32 modulo32 arithmetic exactly.

minimum_complete_model_proposed_not_writ.role: Six16KiB slots in one98304-byte64bit memory with one total RW access grant per clk, partitioned for ownership. Finite AXI AW/AR holders (one each), one R and one B response holder, explicit ready/valid, W follows accepted AW. Arbitration between DMA read, DMA write, compute read and compute write permits only one memory operation per edge. Read response earliest next edge; queues and data remain stable when stalled.

One actual multiplier module, one ADD datapath, operand/accumulator and i/j/k registers, controller FSM. Distinct issue/wait/accumulate/advance/store states; no instantaneous C++ tile update. The FSM waits for memory grants/responses and real multiplier valid. A MAC needs both A and B reads; even ideal issue cannot exceed oneMAC/two total SPM access cycles without extra ports/reuse, before control, writes and DMA contention.

Private integration of existing system fabric, synthetic CPU disabled; replace dummy mst1 endpoint with bounded SPM mapping outside DDR route, expose compute start/ready/done/events. All current DMA/IOMMU handshakes retained; do not count512×8B DMA FIFO as any matrix slot.

Source-defined s/t scheduler plus explicit slot generations and per-step controller charge; same g_cycle updates DDR/SPM/MAC. Full uint32 reference result and per-generation event checks; no offline delay lookup.

storage_and_arithmetic_cost.read_and_response_queue_cost: AW context1, AR context1, R holder1, B holder1, compute response/state; count all widths and outstanding limits in eventual implementation
storage_and_arithmetic_cost.datapath: One existing XLEN64 multiplier with its128-bit product pipeline, one registered32-bit modular accumulator fed by actual ADD datapath, two operands and index/generation/controller registers. No eight-way free MAC duplication.
storage_and_arithmetic_cost.thread_controller: Eight OpenMP workers are replaced by one explicit model scheduler, including DMA issue/wait, barriers and controller state/handshake cycles. No claim to reproduce OpenMP instruction cost; controller abstraction must be stated in application-model contract.
storage_and_arithmetic_cost.non_overlap: DMA and compute compete at the one SPM port; controller, RAM response, multiply pipeline, accumulation and stores consume modeled cycles. More banking/ports, multiplier lanes or cache capacity are architecture changes and must be counted.

executable_timing_routes.measures: Cycles of this defined engine/SPM model while executing exact tile values. C_j emerges from finite-port operation/service trace, including DMA contention; no guessed fixed delay.
executable_timing_routes.clock: Use same clk_i/g_cycle as the existing shared DDR model. A new accelerator model frequency is unspecified; no conversion to CVA6 or FPGA nanoseconds.
executable_timing_routes.faithfulness_limit: Kernel code proves arithmetic/dependency/work count only. One multiplier per modeled engine or eight lanes cannot be equated to eight PULP software cores. The serialFSM schedule is an explicit model architecture; it is not observed application timing. A faithful original workload would need its runtime/PE memory system and actual measured timing.
executable_timing_routes.reuse_boundary: Ordinary legal A/B reuse and caching must remain available under the fixed total storage/port/compute budget. Do not force per-s cold B or forbid normal retained values to create benefit. If a legal simpler reuse removes a registered loss, that loss cannot support a new-rule claim.
executable_timing_routes.scope_judgment: A one-tile scalar engine plus finite single-portSPM and six-slot s/tcontroller is a bounded private model. Claiming original eight-thread timing or adding an eight-PE banked/cache/coherent cluster expands this into a new accelerator system and is rejected as small adaptation.
executable_timing_routes.when_executable: After root explicitly chooses this model contract and these private modules are authored, reviewed, built and checked. Current task intentionally did not implement/build them.

review_addendum_20261012.scope: 事实和技术预算增补；未实现/编译/运行新RTL或kernel。root保留本轮来源/功能关口裁决。

ordinary_16KiB_COPY.mode: N=false / ordinary streaming COPY, batch off; no fullbuffer proof assumed
ordinary_16KiB_COPY.why: 64bitnum_bytes直接作为请求length；wrapper长度类型独立于BufferDepth并启用hardwarelegalizer，剩余长度被逐burst扣减。BufferDepth512×8B是4KiB搬运FIFO容量，不是正常COPY最大长度。
ordinary_16KiB_COPY.burst_shape_condition: 在当前64bit总线、源/目的16KiB区域页对齐、deburst=0且正常INCR的条件下，AXI最大256beats即2KiB，16KiB需要8个read/8个write合法burst；每burst不跨4KiB。非对齐可产生更多burst，不能免费按8计算。
ordinary_16KiB_COPY.batch_boundary: batch_cfg_ok明确要求num_bytes==4096。16KiB应使用普通single-program/NEXT_ID/DONE路径，不能沿用batch64计数。
ordinary_16KiB_COPY.certificate_boundary: idma_fullbuffer_certificate只对一个对齐4096Bjob给fullbuffer许可，且源码明确它不改变accepted/retired握手。16KiB不会得到该许可；不能据此推断普通COPY非法，也不能据此打开N依赖论证。
ordinary_16KiB_COPY.read_admission_boundary: 生产bankedCTL在W未填满时给当前owner读许可，完整缓冲证书只是另一个读admission旁路；它没有把普通请求length裁成4096。
ordinary_16KiB_COPY.private_driver_minimum: 当前program_single把REG_NB写PAGE_BYTES=4096。私有driver应改为length参数，batchenable=0、CONF=0、SRC/DST合法、NB=16384；NEXT_ID触发、DONE精确匹配。按实际cfgAXI事务计费；完整源/目的16KiB页映射、SPM端点与coverage检查仍须补齐。
ordinary_16KiB_COPY.production_note_scope: 生产N说明明确larger/multi-jobstream超当前prototype依赖论证。它限制N安全主张，不取消iDMA普通streaming接口；本事实不声称16KiB共享性能或FPGA时序已验证。
